append.detail: resolveModerator in app/(main)/feed/report-actions.ts returned the caller on community host alone, and host is self-granted by publishing a Circle, so any such member could suspend anyone, hide any post and cancel any event through the admin-client report queue. It now returns { caller, platform } where platform is canModeratePlatform(webRole) or community-domain staff write; a host resolves with platform=false. warnMember, suspendMember and cancelEventFromReport require platform; reviewReport (hide or dismiss) requires platform or, for a post/comment report, canModeratePost against the caller's hosted circle ids. Every action reads reporter_id and refuses the caller's own report; suspendMember refuses self, web_role staff/moderators and team_members rows. The /admin/moderation queue widget narrows a non-platform host to post/comment reports inside Circles they host. Pinned by runtime tests in app/(main)/feed/report-actions.test.ts (host refused on suspend/warn/cancel/out-of-circle hide with no writes; host hides in-circle; staff and community-domain staff act; self-report and staff targets refused).
